labels: protocol-correct srcOrigin provenance (src-20/counterparty/acme) + tests

New pure labels.js srcOriginFor(asset) fixes ACME/Counterparty reps being stamped
bitcoin:src-20:... on-chain. Isolated from recovery.js (re-verify target stays frozen).
test/labels.test.js 4/4; total 13/13; lint clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: record stored-secret self-push method (no chat-paste)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit R05 Step-2: durable recovery (F06 deposit+move resume/rollback, BTC UTXO lock, CI tests)

- verify-deposit: op-state-keyed idempotency (deposit-identity op_key) — completed=idempotent,
  reserved/reconcile=reconcile (no auto-retry), retarget guard, no-op=resume. Crash-safe F06.
- move: burn-identity resume + rollback — source decrement kept on dest-mint fail (retryable unit
  is just the dest mint; resubmit same burn to resume); over-circulating frees the burn.
- withBtcVaultLock: global shared-UTXO serialization across all custody releases (redeem + stamp).
- recovery.js: pure F06 decision logic + test/recovery.test.js (node --test) 9/9; server uses it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit quick-wins: operator-token timing-safe compare + operator reconcile tool

- isOperator: constant-time safeEqual (crypto.timingSafeEqual) replaces === (timing leak)
- GET/POST /api/reconcile (operator-only): resolve stuck redeem rows (reconcile/pending)
  that redeemedBase() counts forever and can block mints. released=finalize/decrement,
  failed=restore collateral + free burn. Under withAssetLock; mint-op recovery deferred to R05.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit R05 (part 2): op-guard all mint callers + fix completed-op accounting ordering

- performMint now threads opKey → mintCritical; /api/mint accepts operator op_key; pool-seed
  mints (amm/create sides A+B) pass deterministic op_keys. Every mint entry point except the
  operator demo swap-fund is now crash-safe/idempotent (audit qual: callers omitted opKey).
- opComplete moved to AFTER the accounting writes (was before): a failed accounting no longer
  leaves an op 'completed' with a cached-success that hides under-reported circulating (over-mint/
  insolvency risk). A crash/throw before completion leaves 'reserved' → retry reconciles (never
  re-mints) and surfaces the incomplete accounting. Verified: operator mint reaches mintCritical
  → clean 503 UNFUNDED; lint clean; reads 200 / writes 503.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit register batch: static no-undef gate + schema-readiness hardening

- ESLint no-undef static check + 'npm run lint' script (would have caught the opKey
  ReferenceError). Verified: flags an undefined ref (exit 1); all app files pass clean.
- migrateSchema (R03): SCHEMA_OK granted ONLY after schema check AND historical backfill
  both succeed; a failed backfill keeps writes contained (was: readiness before backfill).
- Maintenance middleware: !SCHEMA_OK now HARD-blocks all writes BEFORE the operator bypass
  (invariants depend on the registry/operations tables).
- opComplete no longer swallows persistence failures — logs loudly for reconciliation.
Verified: boot logs 'SCHEMA_OK=true' only after backfill; reads 200, writes 503.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit 07672db BLOCKER: fix mintCritical opKey signature + verify-deposit throw handling

- mintCritical was using opKey without declaring it in the signature → ReferenceError on
  EVERY mint (only masked because the mint path is maintenance-blocked). Added opKey=null param.
  Runtime-verified: operator /api/mint now reaches mintCritical and returns clean 503 UNFUNDED,
  not 500. Idempotency verified: duplicate op_key hits the PRIMARY KEY → no re-mint.
- mintCritical uncertain-outcome returns now flag reconcile:true (so verify-deposit does NOT
  revert a credit whose mint may have succeeded → prevents circulating>collateral insolvency).
- verify-deposit: wrap the mint call — a THROW after the credit INSERT keeps the credit (never
  revert a possibly-successful mint) + flags reconciliation; definite pre-send failure reverts
  (retryable); uncertain keeps (reconcile).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit R05 (part 1): durable operation records for crash-safe minting (F06/F07)

- operations table (op_key PRIMARY KEY = cross-process idempotency) + opReserve/opComplete/
  opFail/opReconcile helpers; added to startup schema check
- mintCritical now op-guarded: RESERVE before the on-chain mint, mark COMPLETED (with txid)
  BEFORE the accounting writes → a failed DB update can no longer cause a re-mint on retry (F07);
  a retry of a completed op returns idempotently; UNFUNDED/BADADDR (pre-send) → retryable,
  any other mint error → reconcile (never re-mint an uncertain outcome)
- deposit-mint + move-mint pass deterministic op_keys
- verify-deposit F06: revert the collateral credit on a definite pre-send mint failure so the
  deposit is retryable; keep it (reconcile) on an uncertain outcome

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit 621499e: R06 burn finality + R07 truthful status

R06: burns must be FINAL before authorizing a Bitcoin release (a shallow burn can reorg
  out after the asset is gone). Solana verifier now queries at 'finalized'; EVM verifier
  returns confirmation depth and verifyRepBurn enforces a per-chain minimum (base 3,
  ethereum 12, base-mainnet 20, env-overridable). Also route base-mainnet burns to the EVM verifier.
R07: stop advertising availability while paused — wrap/route enabled=false + service=maintenance
  + honest reason during maintenance; /api/custody/status deposits_live=false + maintenance note.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit 621499e re-review: fix R01 (containment bypass) + R02 + R03

R01 (critical): maintenance regex blacklist matched raw path but Express dispatches
  case-insensitively w/ optional trailing/double slashes → bypassable (re-exposed F03).
  Replace with DEFAULT-DENY (block all non-GET /api during maintenance, no list to bypass)
  + normPath() aligned to Express dispatch (used by maintenance + rate-limit). PERMANENTLY
  RETIRE (410) legacy /api/redeem, /api/preview/confirm-deposit, and all /api/bridge/intent*
  mutation/poll routes; kill the intent sweep. Verified: uppercase/trailing/double-slash all 503.
R02: redeem catch no longer frees the burn reservation on UNKNOWN broadcast outcome — only a
  proven pre-send GATED failure is retryable; uncertainty → keep consumed + status='reconcile'.
R03: startup migrateSchema() verifies burn-registry schema (fail-loud → containment holds if
  missing) + idempotent backfill of historical move-out/redeem burns into consumed_burns.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit PR3: authorized burns (owner-bound releases/moves + shared consume-once)

- evm-mint/sol-mint verifyBurn now return the real BURNER (Transfer.from / burn authority)
- shared consumed_burns registry (PRIMARY KEY) — one burn authorizes exactly ONE action,
  ever, across redeem AND move (was two separate per-endpoint checks) [F05/F10 class]
- /api/custody/redeem: require an owner signature binding burn→BTC recipient (verifyBurnOwnerSig
  EVM/EIP-191 + Solana/ed25519) so you can't redeem someone else's burn to your address (F05);
  reserve burn before release, free it on definite pre-broadcast failure (retryable) else
  fail-closed (no double-release)
- /api/move: shared consume-once + record burner; normalize txids (EVM lowercase, Solana as-is)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit fixes: F09 excess-precision guard, F08 mint-capability check, ACME redeem decimals

- verify-deposit: reject amounts with more precision than the source asset (F09 — a
  1-unit indivisible deposit could mint 1.9); unit-tested against the exploit
- verify-deposit: fail-closed if destination chain isn't a real mint target (F08 —
  base-mainnet was advertised but mintCritical would reject after recording the claim)
- custody redeem: carry the asset's real source decimals (was hardcoded 8) and pass
  authoritative qtyBase for ACME so the composed-quantity assertion actually runs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit 2345961 PR1: maintenance containment

Single choke-point (before any DB write/signer call) disabling ALL value-moving /
accounting-changing routes while remediation proceeds — neutralizes F01-F10 at once:
- redeem, custody/redeem, verify-deposit, mint, mint/migrate-authority, move,
  amm/create, amm/swap, amm/deploy-mock, preview/confirm-deposit, stampbridge/execute
- legacy intent paths incl. POST bridge/intent/:id/txid + GET bridge/intent/:id (F03)
- intent background sweep disabled in maintenance
- operator header bypass for reviewed back-office; /api/status + UI maintenance banner
- reads/discovery + deployed Uniswap trading unaffected. Toggle STAMPY_MAINTENANCE=0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit residuals: fail-loud key loading + operator-gate /api/move

- evm-signer/sol-mint/squads/safe: refuse to auto-generate keys if file missing
  (STAMPY_ALLOW_KEYGEN=1 to intentionally init) — prevents silent key rotation / stranded funds
- /api/move operator-only (was public mint + unbound burn = front-run/gas-drain)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Audit 2345961: fix P0 vault-safety + key P1s

P0 (fixed):
- /api/custody/redeem: require on-chain BURN PROOF (non-operator) + crash-safe pending ledger
  row before broadcast + burn_txid idempotency (was: released vault on SQL counter alone = drain)
- /api/redeem: blocked unless preview/operator (was public accounting-only burn desyncing PoR)
- /api/amm/swap: operator-only (was unauthenticated protocol-inventory minting)
P1 (fixed):
- verify-deposit uses resolveAsset (ACME/SOAP collision)
- Uniswap swap minOut = quote-50bps; addLiquidity mins = 99% (were 0)
- ACME_CONFIRMATIONS default 3 (was 1)
- wrap/route preview reflects real mainnet state (was always testnet)
- XCP deposit-mint frozen to operator-only pending per-tx attribution
- redeemedBase excludes failed redeems

Custody stays GATED OFF until residuals cleared. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
